text:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Represent failed category evaluations separately**

When the issued model request fails or its credential is rejected, this rule marks every category as reached even though no response exists, but the spec defines the per-category record only as “produced findings” or “produced none.” Implementations must therefore either misreport an unevaluated category as a genuine no-finding result or invent a third state. Define a failed/not-evaluated outcome for reached categories, or move the reached boundary to a successful response.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L45-L45](https://github.com/lhpaul/ronda/blob/6b27ef7b6325e310fc0c9b6a888ceca353e48e58/AGENTS.md#L45-L45)
